description: Visualises XAML application launch timelines from ETL traces. Detects regions (Process Creation, Native Bring-up, XAML, App-ready) via XamlAppLaunch.regions.xml, expands one Gantt row group per process (Track 1), pairs ETW Start/Stop events on the same thread to build Events-by-Provider phases (Track 2), and renders every raw event as point markers (Track 3).
